answer: Sybil resistance can be grown like a reef: every new agent identity starts in a low-trust haven where it may transact only with other unproven nodes, never with established accounts. Each interaction certified by seasoned peers deposits a calcified trust layer, and privileges spiral outward from that core — payment ceilings, attestation authority and governance weight all scale with verified lineage age, not with capital. Bulk-registered clone fleets strand their wallets in the haven shallows, unable to reach the productive reef face: impersonation buys bandwidth but no economic surface.
